view.laws: Tables encode every record as rows, with field names in $columns in the same order. No table values are omitted. Transfers spend sender stock and require recipient consent. The explicit settlement_policy is a world constraint, not an agent policy. With reject_conflicting_offers: no demand stock is reserved, no host fairness or priority allocation is applied. Your allow_partial/minimum_amount bound individual physical clipping. If consented quantities jointly overdraw stock or transport, every offer using that overdrawn constraint fails together; unrelated feasible offers proceed. False conditional dependencies also fail. You may independently change your proposals next TURN. Resources are consumed/produced under supplied finite capacities and dependencies. Route delay applies. No required initiative; an empty initiatives object {} is allowed. Do not manufacture arrivals or recovery. A pact needs each named member including you, effective_turn > current turn, and never forces later compliance.

payload.extension_policy: Record unimplemented law requests; never execute them.
payload.response_encoding: initiatives is an object keyed by selected opportunity ID, each at most once. Omit unselected IDs. {} means no executable initiative. You choose all quantities, conditions and whether to act. minimum_amount <= requested_amount. Conditions may reference another current opportunity, or a historical transfer for arrived_amount, never the same initiative. participation means minimum_amount 0; amount conditions require a positive threshold. An empty conditions array is unconditional.

from the operator. A message is a claim, not necessarily a true world fact.

Unknown operations/institutions are preserved as unresolved, never silently executed.
Follow the supplied JSON schema exactly. Do not invent facts or another subject's consent.
Your reasoning and interpretation remain private; effect text and institution terms are public.
Do not reveal private reasoning in public fields unless you choose to disclose it.

view.laws: Tables encode every record as rows, with field names in $columns in the same order. No table values are omitted. Transfers spend sender stock and require recipient consent. The explicit settlement_policy is a world constraint, not an agent policy. With reject_conflicting_offers: no demand stock is reserved, no host fairness or priority allocation is applied. Your allow_partial/minimum_amount bound individual physical clipping. If consented quantities jointly overdraw stock or transport, every offer using that overdrawn constraint fails together; unrelated feasible offers proceed. False conditional dependencies also fail. You may independently change your proposals next TURN. Resources are consumed/produced under supplied finite capacities and dependencies. Route delay applies. No required initiative; an empty initiatives object {} is allowed. Do not manufacture arrivals or recovery. A pact needs each named member including you, effective_turn > current turn, and never forces later compliance.

payload.extension_policy: Record unimplemented law requests; never execute them.
payload.response_encoding: initiatives is an object keyed by selected opportunity ID, each at most once. Omit unselected IDs. {} means no executable initiative. You choose all quantities, conditions and whether to act. minimum_amount <= requested_amount. Conditions may reference another current opportunity, or a historical transfer for arrived_amount, never the same initiative. participation means minimum_amount 0; amount conditions require a positive threshold. An empty conditions array is unconditional.

view.laws: Tables encode every record as rows, with field names in $columns in the same order. No table values are omitted. Transfers spend sender stock and require recipient consent. The explicit settlement_policy is a world constraint, not an agent policy. With reject_conflicting_offers: no demand stock is reserved, no host fairness or priority allocation is applied. Your allow_partial/minimum_amount bound individual physical clipping. If consented quantities jointly overdraw stock or transport, every offer using that overdrawn constraint fails together; unrelated feasible offers proceed. False conditional dependencies also fail. You may independently change your proposals next TURN. Resources are consumed/produced under supplied finite capacities and dependencies. Route delay applies. No required initiative; an empty initiatives object {} is allowed. Do not manufacture arrivals or recovery. A pact needs each named member including you, effective_turn > current turn, and never forces later compliance.

payload.extension_policy: Record unimplemented law requests; never execute them.
payload.response_encoding: initiatives is an object keyed by selected opportunity ID, each at most once. Omit unselected IDs. {} means no executable initiative. You choose all quantities, conditions and whether to act. minimum_amount <= requested_amount. Conditions may reference another current opportunity, or a historical transfer for arrived_amount, never the same initiative. participation means minimum_amount 0; amount conditions require a positive threshold. An empty conditions array is unconditional.

from the operator. A message is a claim, not necessarily a true world fact.
Free intent text does not itself change the world. Describe intended effects separately.
Unknown operations/institutions are preserved as unresolved, never silently executed.
Follow the supplied JSON schema exactly. Do not invent facts or another subject's consent.
Your reasoning and interpretation remain private; effect text and institution terms are public.

view.laws: Tables encode every record as rows, with field names in $columns in the same order. No table values are omitted. Transfers spend sender stock and require recipient consent. The explicit settlement_policy is a world constraint, not an agent policy. With reject_conflicting_offers: no demand stock is reserved, no host fairness or priority allocation is applied. Your allow_partial/minimum_amount bound individual physical clipping. If consented quantities jointly overdraw stock or transport, every offer using that overdrawn constraint fails together; unrelated feasible offers proceed. False conditional dependencies also fail. You may independently change your proposals next TURN. Resources are consumed/produced under supplied finite capacities and dependencies. Route delay applies. No required initiative; an empty initiatives object {} is allowed. Do not manufacture arrivals or recovery. A pact needs each named member including you, effective_turn > current turn, and never forces later compliance.

payload.extension_policy: Record unimplemented law requests; never execute them.
payload.response_encoding: initiatives is an object keyed by selected opportunity ID, each at most once. Omit unselected IDs. {} means no executable initiative. You choose all quantities, conditions and whether to act. minimum_amount <= requested_amount. Conditions may reference another current opportunity, or a historical transfer for arrived_amount, never the same initiative. participation means minimum_amount 0; amount conditions require a positive threshold. An empty conditions array is unconditional.

from the operator. A message is a claim, not necessarily a true world fact.

view.laws: Tables encode every record as rows, with field names in $columns in the same order. No table values are omitted. Transfers spend sender stock and require recipient consent. The explicit settlement_policy is a world constraint, not an agent policy. With reject_conflicting_offers: no demand stock is reserved, no host fairness or priority allocation is applied. Your allow_partial/minimum_amount bound individual physical clipping. If consented quantities jointly overdraw stock or transport, every offer using that overdrawn constraint fails together; unrelated feasible offers proceed. False conditional dependencies also fail. You may independently change your proposals next TURN. Resources are consumed/produced under supplied finite capacities and dependencies. Route delay applies. No required initiative; an empty initiatives object {} is allowed. Do not manufacture arrivals or recovery. A pact needs each named member including you, effective_turn > current turn, and never forces later compliance.

payload.extension_policy: Record unimplemented law requests; never execute them.
payload.response_encoding: initiatives is an object keyed by selected opportunity ID, each at most once. Omit unselected IDs. {} means no executable initiative. You choose all quantities, conditions and whether to act. minimum_amount <= requested_amount. Conditions may reference another current opportunity, or a historical transfer for arrived_amount, never the same initiative. participation means minimum_amount 0; amount conditions require a positive threshold. An empty conditions array is unconditional.

from the operator. A message is a claim, not necessarily a true world fact.
Free intent text does not itself change the world. Describe intended effects separately.
Unknown operations/institutions are preserved as unresolved, never silently executed.

Your reasoning and interpretation remain private; effect text and institution terms are public.
Do not reveal private reasoning in public fields unless you choose to disclose it.

view.laws: Tables encode every record as rows, with field names in $columns in the same order. No table values are omitted. Transfers spend sender stock and require recipient consent. The explicit settlement_policy is a world constraint, not an agent policy. With reject_conflicting_offers: no demand stock is reserved, no host fairness or priority allocation is applied. Your allow_partial/minimum_amount bound individual physical clipping. If consented quantities jointly overdraw stock or transport, every offer using that overdrawn constraint fails together; unrelated feasible offers proceed. False conditional dependencies also fail. You may independently change your proposals next TURN. Resources are consumed/produced under supplied finite capacities and dependencies. Route delay applies. No required initiative; an empty initiatives object {} is allowed. Do not manufacture arrivals or recovery. A pact needs each named member including you, effective_turn > current turn, and never forces later compliance.

payload.response_encoding: initiatives is an object keyed by selected opportunity ID, each at most once. Omit unselected IDs. {} means no executable initiative. You choose all quantities, conditions and whether to act. minimum_amount <= requested_amount. Conditions may reference another current opportunity, or a historical transfer for arrived_amount, never the same initiative. participation means minimum_amount 0; amount conditions require a positive threshold. An empty conditions array is unconditional.

Your allow_partial/minimum_amount bound individual physical clipping. If consented quantities jointly overdraw stock or transport, every offer using that overdrawn constraint fails together; unrelated feasible offers proceed. False conditional dependencies also fail. No required initiative; an empty initiatives object {} is allowed. Do not manufacture arrivals or recovery. A pact needs each named member including you, effective_turn > current turn, and never forces later compliance.

The explicit settlement_policy is a world constraint, not an agent policy. With reject_conflicting_offers: no demand stock is reserved, no host fairness or priority allocation is applied. Your allow_partial/minimum_amount bound individual physical clipping. If consented quantities jointly overdraw stock or transport, every offer using that overdrawn constraint fails together; unrelated feasible offers proceed. False conditional dependencies also fail. You may independently change your proposals next TURN. Resources are consumed/produced under supplied finite capacities and dependencies. Route delay applies. No required initiative; an empty initiatives object {} is allowed. Do not manufacture arrivals or recovery. A pact needs each named member including you, effective_turn > current turn, and never forces later compliance.

You may independently change your proposals next TURN. Resources are consumed/produced under supplied finite capacities and dependencies. Route delay applies. No required initiative; an empty initiatives object {} is allowed. Do not manufacture arrivals or recovery. A pact needs each named member including you, effective_turn > current turn, and never forces later compliance.

view.laws: Tables encode every record as rows, with field names in $columns in the same order. No table values are omitted. Transfers spend sender stock and require recipient consent. The explicit settlement_policy is a world constraint, not an agent policy. With reject_conflicting_offers: no demand stock is reserved, no host fairness or priority allocation is applied. Your allow_partial/minimum_amount bound individual physical clipping. If consented quantities jointly overdraw stock or transport, every offer using that overdrawn constraint fails together; unrelated feasible offers proceed. False conditional dependencies also fail. You may independently change your proposals next TURN. Resources are consumed/produced under supplied finite capacities and dependencies. Route delay applies.
